hints.title: Prefix Aggregate Value Tallying
hints.text: Associate keys with numeric scores so that prefix queries compute the cumulative sum of all keys possessing the inquiry prefix.

hints.title: Prefix Score Differential Propagation
hints.text: Store existing key values in a map. When inserting a key, calculate the delta (new value minus old value) and add delta to each node along the prefix path.

hints.title: MapSum Blueprint
hints.text: In init: root has score = 0 and children. map stores key -> val. In insert(key, val): delta = val - map.get(key, 0), map[key] = val, traverse key adding delta to node.score. In sum(prefix): traverse to prefix node, return node.score or 0 if prefix not found.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: length of inserted key or query prefix
complexity.notes: Both insert and sum queries execute in linear time relative to string length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-traversing and summing all descendants on every query takes O(N * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains running score sum in each trie node for O(K) instant retrieval.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of key overrides using delta subtraction.
